svg.text: Plan view (A), a quadrat seen from the side (B) and the in-place shoot measurements (C). Illustrative, not to scale.
A · Plan view: depth + photo every 2 m; three quadrats in a line across the tape at front, centre and back
every 2 m: depth (gauge or metered stick) + time + one vertical photo for cover
B · At each quadrat (9 per transect)
Then measure 5 shoots of the dominant species in place (nearest
to marked points on the frame). Nothing is collected.
C · On each shoot, in place
